outcome: The revision tax gets a deterministic gate: plan recording computes the reverse-dependency closure of every slice's scope and refuses to record when a package containing tests or golden fixtures that pin scope-package behaviour lies outside scope and is not explicitly waived in the plan, so under-derived scope is caught at authoring time instead of after a sealed candidate dies.

exclude: heuristic or model-judged lint (deterministic import analysis only)
changing scope semantics at seal or candidate validation
blocking on anything outside the repository's own module graph

acceptance.text: Plan recording computes, from the module's import graph, every package outside a slice's scope whose tests import a scope package or whose committed fixtures are regenerated by scope-package tooling, and refuses recording with the named packages unless the plan carries an explicit waiver naming them.

The four historical instances are the regression corpus: recorded plan fixtures reproducing the rev1 conformance-gate pin gap, the configurable-paths S1 and S2 scope gaps, and the tools/batongolden golden-corpus gap each refuse with the missing package named.
A plan with a waiver records successfully and the waiver text is preserved in the recorded bytes, so operator judgement stays possible and visible.

The lint lives in the recording path shared by any recorder (the engine's plan admission), not in a sidecar binary, and runs identically at proposal validation so planners see the refusal before operators do.

constraints: Deterministic only: import-graph facts and declared fixture relationships; no model judgement anywhere in the gate.
Refusal names the packages and the reason; a refusal the author cannot act on is the defect class this release exists to end.
Evidence basis: four under-derived-scope instances in one week cost two plan revisions and a lost ~900-turn candidate (sworn#199).
The e2e check is declared, not executed by a role (ADR 0010).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
